results.title: Fogging programme suspended until further notice
results.description: The Ministry of Health and Wellness’ Vector Control Unit has suspended its fogging programme until further notice. The Ministry said an announcement will be made when the programme resumes. The Unit thanked members of the public for their understanding and apologised for any inconvenience caused by the suspension. The post Fogging programme suspended until further notice appeared first on nationnews.com .
